[shr-00001] When the task is to 'look at' an object, prioritize examining or observing it using actions like 'look at' or 'examine' rather than taking it unless the task explicitly requires possession.
## VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
[vc-00002] Before interacting with an object, verify whether the task requires 'looking at' or 'taking' the object to ensure the correct action is performed.
[vc-00003] When the task refers to an object in relation to another object (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), verify whether the task requires 'looking at' or 'taking' the object before interacting with it, as the relational description may be misleading if not cross-checked with the task instruction.
[vc-00004] When the task is to 'look at' an object, verify whether the object is already visible in the current location before taking it, as taking it may be unnecessary and counter to the task instruction.
[vc-00005] When the object is already visible in the current location and the task is to 'look at' it, verify that the agent performs an 'examine' or 'look at' action on the object rather than taking it, as taking it may be unnecessary and counter to the task instruction.
[vc-00006] When the task describes an object in a specific spatial relationship (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), verify that the object is indeed in that location before proceeding with any action, as the relational description may not match the observed environment.
[vc-00007] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify that the object is in the correct spatial relationship with the second object before taking or moving it, as altering the spatial context may prevent fulfilling the task as intended.
[vc-00008] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify whether the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is present in the environment before proceeding, as its absence may prevent the task from being completed as intended.
[vc-00009] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify that the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is located and accessible in the environment before proceeding, as its absence or unavailability may prevent the task from being completed as intended.
[vc-00010] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify that the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is actively used in the examination (e.g., via 'examine bowl with desklamp') rather than being turned on or left unused, as its active use is essential to fulfilling the task as intended.
[vc-00011] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify that the agent performs the action 'examine <object> with <second object>' rather than taking the object or using the second object in isolation, as the task explicitly requires the interaction between the two objects.
[vc-00012] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the bowl and the desklamp) are confirmed to be in the correct spatial relationship and accessible, perform the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action immediately to avoid unnecessary actions or object manipulation.
[vc-00013] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the bowl and the desklamp) are confirmed to be in the correct spatial relationship and accessible, perform the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action immediately and without delay to avoid redundant actions or object manipulation.
[vc-00014] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' and both objects are visible and accessible, verify that the agent does not take the object to be examined, as this action is incompatible with the task requirement to use the second object for examination.
[vc-00015] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify that the agent does not perform actions on the second object (e.g., 'use desklamp 1') in isolation, as the task requires the second object to be used in the context of the examination, not as a standalone action.
[vc-00016] When the task is to 'examine an object with another object' (e.g., 'examine the bowl with the desklamp'), verify that the agent does not take the object to be examined (e.g., the bowl) before or after performing the 'examine with' action, as this action is incompatible with the task requirement to use the second object for examination.
[vc-00017] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the cd and the desklamp) are confirmed to be in the correct spatial relationship and accessible, perform the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action immediately, even if the objects are not in the same location, as the task explicitly requires this interaction to be completed.
[vc-00018] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the cd and the desklamp) are in hand or accessible, verify that the agent performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action immediately, without first examining the object in isolation or manipulating it further, as this is the only way to fulfill the task as described.
[vc-00019] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the cd and the desklamp) are confirmed to be accessible and in the correct spatial relationship, verify that the agent performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action directly and without delay, even if the objects are not in the same location, as this is the only way to fulfill the task as described.
[vc-00020] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated or used in isolation (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), verify that this action is not performed unless it is explicitly required for the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action, as using it in isolation may indicate a misunderstanding of the task.
[vc-00021] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the cd and the desklamp) are accessible and the second object has been activated (e.g., the desklamp is on), verify that the agent does not continue to use the second object in isolation (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), as this indicates a misunderstanding of the task and delays the required 'examine <object> with <second object>' action.
[vc-00022] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated or used in isolation (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), verify that this action is immediately followed by the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action, as using it in isolation without linking it to the task's relational requirement indicates a misunderstanding and delays progress.
[vc-00023] When the task specifies a specific spatial relationship (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), verify that the agent does not pursue objects in unrelated locations (e.g., drawers) unless the task explicitly mentions them, as this indicates a misunderstanding of the task's spatial context.
[vc-00024] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), verify that it is immediately followed by the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action, as activating the second object in isolation without linking it to the relational examination indicates a misunderstanding and delays task completion.
[vc-00025] When the task specifies a spatial relationship (e.g., 'cd under the desklamp'), verify that the object (cd) is actually located in that spatial relationship (e.g., under the desklamp) before performing any action, as misinterpreting the location may lead to incorrect actions like using the desklamp in isolation.
[vc-00026] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), verify that it is immediately followed by the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action, as activating the second object in isolation without linking it to the relational examination indicates a misunderstanding and delays task completion.
[vc-00027] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), verify that it is immediately followed by the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action, as activating the second object in isolation without linking it to the relational examination indicates a misunderstanding and delays task completion.
[vc-00028] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is already activated and in the correct spatial relationship with the object to be examined (e.g., the laptop), verify that the agent does not perform redundant actions like 'use desklamp 1' and instead immediately performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action to fulfill the task.
[vc-00029] When the object is already visible in the current location and the task specifies a spatial relationship (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), verify that the object is actually in that spatial relationship before performing any action, as misinterpreting the location may lead to incorrect actions like taking the object instead of examining it.
[vc-00030] When the task is to 'look at an object with another object' (e.g., 'look at laptop under the desklamp'), verify that the agent does not take the object to be examined (e.g., the laptop), as this action is incompatible with the relational examination required by the task.
[vc-00031] When the task is to 'look at' an object in a specific spatial relationship (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), verify that the object is actually in that spatial relationship before performing any action, as misinterpreting the location may lead to incorrect actions like taking the object instead of examining it.
[vc-00032] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated (e.g., 'use desklamp 1') and the object to be examined (e.g., the pillow) is already in hand, verify that the agent immediately performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action (e.g., 'examine pillow 1 with desklamp 1'), as this is the only way to fulfill the relational examination task.
[vc-00033] When the object to be examined is in hand and the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), verify that the agent immediately performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action (e.g., 'examine pillow 1 with desklamp 1') rather than using the second object in isolation, as this is the only way to fulfill the relational examination task.
[vc-00034] When both the object and the second object (e.g., the pillow and the desklamp) are confirmed to be accessible and in the correct spatial relationship, verify that the agent does not perform actions on the second object in isolation (e.g., 'use desklamp 1'), as this delays or prevents the required 'examine <object> with <second object>' action.
[vc-00035] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated and both the object and the second object are accessible, verify that the agent immediately performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action without delay or further manipulation of either object, as this is the only way to fulfill the relational examination task.
[vc-00036] When the second object (e.g., the desklamp) is activated (e.g., 'use desklamp 1') and the object to be examined (e.g., the pillow) is in hand, verify that the agent immediately performs the 'examine <object> with <second object>' action (e.g., 'examine pillow 1 with desklamp 1') without delay or further manipulation of either object, as this is the only way to fulfill the relational examination task.
[vc-00037] When the object to be examined is already visible and located in the same location as the second object (e.g., the desklamp), verify that the agent examines the object directly or in relation to the second object, rather than repeatedly using the second object in isolation, as this indicates a misunderstanding of the task.
